name: Reactive stablecoin-inflow FADE short (daily, late-money crowding into a stretched swing)
rationale: MECHANISM: on a daily bar, a large sustained stablecoin_net_flow_usd inflow arriving after an already-extended multi-day up-move (ret_Nd strongly positive, bb_z high) is late crowding money — the reactive/lagging flow the VAR literature documents. Fading it targets the multi-day mean-reversion that follows exhaustion of trend-chasers. Distinct from the intraday 4h fades by hold length and the multi-day extension window. Other side = retail deploying freshly-moved stables at the top. DISCONFIRMER: if the fade also works without the price-extension gate (bb_z / ret_Nd), the flow feature is decorative and it is a plain overbought short. Also fails if net-of-fees the short cannot overcome structural long-drift + funding on a multi-day hold — weak inflow signals (corr<0.3) rarely deliver a reliable daily reversal.
catalyst: sustained reactive stablecoin inflow into a stretched multi-day up-move
